leadText: Hiroki Touchi (Japanese: 東地宏樹 Tōchi Hiroki) is a Japanese voice actor for and .
plainText:
Hiroki Touchi (Japanese: 東地宏樹 Tōchi Hiroki) is a Japanese voice actor for and .

==Biography==
Touchi was born on May 26, 1966, in , . He became a voice actor as an adult and led a prolific career since the 1980s. Touchi provided his voice for Team Plasma scientist Colress during . He also voiced Team Flare leader Lysandre in Pokémon Generations and Kabu in . He is currently affiliated with Office Osawa.
